facts.text: Andrew expresses a desire to spend time in nature by visiting nearby parks or going on hikes.

evidence.quote: Yeah, living in the city, I do miss nature a lot. Whenever I can, I try to go to nearby parks or on hikes.

facts.text: Audrey mentions that she has not taken her furry friends for a walk recently due to a busy lifestyle.

evidence.quote: Life's been crazy lately so it's been a while since I took my furry friends out for a walk.

facts.text: Andrew acknowledges the therapeutic value of nature and animals, and encourages Audrey to go on a hike with her dogs.

evidence.quote: Nature and animals can be so peaceful and joyful. I hope you and your furry buddies go on some fun adventures soon!

facts.text: Audrey states that she intends to go on a hike with her dogs as a form of therapy.

evidence.quote: Yeah, I need to go on a hike with them, it's going to be a great therapy!
